subject: Security onboarding: IAM & evidence next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@novaclinic.com>, security_ops@novaclinic.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding: IAM & evidence next steps

Hi Olivia / Nova security team,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have one place to track: 

Call recap (30 min):
- Use case: patient-facing summarization and internal clinical search (PII scope to be clarified)
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA for PHI, GDPR for EU patients, and vendor risk gate for SOC 2 evidence
- Identity baseline: you currently use Okta for SSO (SAML) and partially use SCIM for user provisioning

Open items / asks:
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether Nova Clinic has SOC 2 Type II in scope for hosted vendors, and if a report or bridge letter is available?
2) Data residency / processing: which regions will Redwood serve for Nova production? (We support US/EU dedicated routing)
3) HIPAA BA/requirements: confirm whether you require a BA agreement and any specific controls beyond standard PHI handling
4) IAM evidence: for SSO/SAML and SCIM please share examples of the following artifacts when available:
   - SAML metadata / IdP configuration snippet
   - SCIM provisioning logs or API access examples
   - RBAC/role matrix for admin vs end-user privileges
   - Admin audit logs or screenshots for user management flows

Next steps I propose:
- I will send a short vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and a one-page SSO guidance doc to help you map artifacts.
- Please share the POC from your security team so we can coordinate evidence uploads.
- Internal: I have looped in Jonas (SE) who will collect technical artifacts; Neha (security) will handle legal/compliance touchpoints.

Target follow-up: can we aim to have initial IAM artifacts by close of next week (Fri, Mar 12)? If that’s tight, tell us a preferable date.

Attachments: short VSQ and SSO guide attached.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@novaclinic.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@novaclinic.com
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: IAM & evidence next steps

Thanks Camila — appreciated the clear recap. Quick answers below and a couple of questions from our side: 

1) SOC 2: we are currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; our audit is scheduled for late May and we expect a report in mid-June. We can provide our current SOC 2 bridge letter and a controls summary in the meantime.
2) HIPAA: yes, we require a BA and standard HIPAA controls. Our procurement team will trigger the BA once we have initial security artifacts.
3) SSO/SCIM: Okta is our IdP; SAML is used for authentication and SCIM is enabled for some systems but not uniformly. We can share SAML metadata and a SCIM API example.

Questions:
- Is there a short list of mandatory artifacts you need to start an evaluation vs. optional ones?
- Who should our security ops inbox send the documents to?

I will coordinate with security_ops@novaclinic.com and put them in touch with your team. Expect an initial package (bridge letter + SAML metadata) early next week.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Product Operations, Nova Clinic
olivia@novaclinic.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: IAM & evidence next steps

Great — thanks Olivia. To make this as frictionless as possible, attached is a one-page list that separates MUST-HAVE artifacts vs NICE-TO-HAVE. High level:

MUST-HAVE (to start a technical security review):
- SOC 2 bridge letter or same-window report (if available)
- SAML IdP metadata or screenshots of Okta SSO app settings
- SCIM provisioning example or logs showing user lifecycle events
- RBAC matrix or a screenshot of role assignments for admin tiers

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Admin audit log exports or recent screenshots showing user modifications
- Documented onboarding/offboarding runbook
- Any penetration test summary or vulnerability tracker link

Action items on our side: Jonas will produce a short checklist for where we need samples and a secure upload link (we can also accept DocuSign/SharePoint links). Neha will coordinate the BA contract and legal asks.

Can you have security_ops send the MUST-HAVE set to security@redwood.example (secure upload) or share a secure link? If you prefer, we can accept the initial package in an encrypted email.

Thanks — we’ll keep this light for now and only ask for what’s necessary to move forward with a POC.

Camila
